title: County Food and Nutrition Security Plan law
summary: Bill 98 puts a Food and Nutrition Security Plan with 131 actions into county code. It requires an online progress dashboard within 120 days and sends five-year updates to the council. The Farm Bureau first asked for a delay and later said it fully supported the bill, which passed final reading 8–0 on September 4.

timeline.text: Bill 98, creating a Food and Nutrition Security Plan, passed final reading with eight ayes and zero noes.
The Maui County Farm Bureau said it fully supports Bill 98.
The Farm Bureau said the committee chair reached out to discuss its concerns.
Members voted to have each five-year plan update sent to the council instead of the county.
